description: Machine-readable inventory of major Atria modules. Generated from docs/01_TRUTH/CODEBASE_INVENTORY.md and current repo.

modules.name: api
responsibilities: FastAPI app and HTTP entrypoint
Startup: dependency checks and mirror load
POST /run and /run/stream dispatch by mode to atria_tools
Mount Vision Execution and Intake routers
Health and CORS
modules.notes: No route calls mirror.get_item_with_content(); product contract is Tier A intake only (see docs/01_TRUTH/TRUTH_CONVERGENCE.md).

modules.name: intake
responsibilities: Email/fax ingestion and normalization
Classification (category, priority), PHI detection and redaction
Lane derivation
Pipeline to IntakeItem and judgment creation
In-memory queue (add, get, update) with write-through to mirror
IMAP/Gmail OAuth config and poll (on-demand only)
persisted_data: Via mirror: queue items and judgment chain on add/update; mirror load repopulates in-memory queue and judgment store at startup
modules.notes: Poll is on-demand only. No mailbox mutation. access_policy.py is deprecated shim to policy.

modules.name: intake_mirror
responsibilities: SQLite intake_mirror.db: mirror_item, mirror_judgment, mirror_sync, mailbox_action
Schema init and migration
Upsert item (Tier A + sanitized_body_text); upsert judgment chain
load_into_memory: rebuild queue and judgment store from mirror
get_item_with_content: Tier B/C access gated by policy
set_sync_state / get_sync_state, record_mailbox_action (APIs exist, not called by poll)
persisted_data: intake_mirror.db at repo root: mirror_item, mirror_judgment, mirror_sync, mailbox_action
modules.notes: mirror_sync and mailbox_action not wired to poll. Tier C raw_content_ref is placeholder only.

modules.name: judgment
responsibilities: In-memory judgment store (JudgmentRecord)
create_intake_judgment, create_correction_record
get_record, get_for_entity, get_supersession_chain
Supersession chain for corrections
persisted_data: None in this module; persistence is via intake_mirror only
modules.notes: Only intake domain in use. No generic multi-domain persistence in judgment layer.

modules.name: policy
responsibilities: Data tiers (A/B/C) and AccessLevel
request_access(level, justification, destination)
require_access; tier_satisfies; access_level_to_tier
Local vs external destination for future egress gating
modules.notes: Only intake mirror get_item_with_content() calls it. Council and File Steward do not use it yet. destination=EXTERNAL unused.

modules.name: adapters
responsibilities: Adapter registry by kind and name
LLMAdapter and MailboxAdapter protocols
Default registration: llm.ollama (OllamaProvider)
modules.notes: No Mailbox adapter registered. Intake does not use adapter for fetch; tools use providers directly for LLM.

modules.name: vision_execution
responsibilities: Ideas, initiatives, projects, tasks, people, assets, decisions, capacity profiles, core profiles
SQLite storage and full CRUD
Radar, derived fields, initiative evaluation, meeting extract
Server-owned council workspace perspective JSON (user_council_workspace)
modules.notes: DB init on first use, not at API startup. Does not use shared policy layer.

modules.name: providers
responsibilities: get_default_provider() / get_council_provider(): OllamaProvider, or per-request policy override (OpenAI) from run_context
generate(prompt, **kwargs) for council, next step, reassess, etc.
modules.notes: Ollama local; OpenAI when policy primary=openai and OPENAI_API_KEY set (see docs/02_ACTIVE_DESIGN/POLICY_PROVIDER_EXECUTION.md).

modules.name: execution_policy
responsibilities: resolve_execution_policy_for_action(context, policy) → primary + fallback_chain + flags (+ privacy)
load_execution_policy_config from config/ai_execution_policy.json or embedded fallback
run_context: push_policy_provider_override / push_ollama_model_override for POST /run when routing_context present

modules.name: delegation_structured_cloud_v1
responsibilities: Compiled delegation: workspace_next_step; initiative_evaluate; core_profile_reconcile + OpenAI + routing (vision_execution + delegation modules)

Workspace: maybe_externalize_for_cloud before generate_next_step_raw; rebind before JSON parse. Initiative compiled: maybe_externalize_structured_initiative_evaluate_for_cloud (initiative_id + user_id substrings), rebind before JSON parse

Tiered direction: general_lane.py (broad compile + optional parse); learning_capture.py non-blocking LearningRecord ring buffer after structured outcomes; privacy-aware redaction for restricted/local_only
modules.notes: See COMPILED_DELEGATION_V1.md and TIERED_DELEGATION_AND_LEARNING.md; shared strict rebind in delegation/externalized_inference.py; learning_record_id on structured paths, core_profile_conversation, idea_evaluate (general capture when routed OpenAI); client outcomes via POST /vision-execution/learning-records/user-outcome; env-gated GET /vision-execution/learning-records/{stats,inspect,export} when ATRIA_LEARNING_EXPORT_ENABLED (test_learning_export.py); optional append-only JSONL ATRIA_LEARNING_PERSIST_PATH (+ ATRIA_LEARNING_PERSIST_MAX_MB) in learning_persist.py, startup in api/main.py (test_learning_persist.py); offline dedupe/summary scripts/atria_learning_jsonl_prep.py + local_ai/delegation/learning_jsonl_prep.py (test_learning_jsonl_prep.py); evidence analysis scripts/atria_learning_analysis.py + local_ai/delegation/learning_record_analysis.py (test_learning_record_analysis.py); tests include test_idea_evaluate_learning.py, test_core_profile_conversation_general_lane.py, test_learning_capture.py, test_delegation_externalized_inference.py.

modules.name: atria_tools
responsibilities: File Steward wrappers: scan_folder, analyze_folder_structure, recommend_child_folders, assess_plan_strength, simulate_folder_plan, reassess_low_confidence
run_council / run_council_stream with optional perspective_definitions
web_research, suggest_next_step
build_council_decision_packet; _build_perspective_system_prompt
modules.notes: Uses get_council_provider/get_default_provider (honors policy override when API set run_context). File steward may use separate paths.

modules.name: frontend
responsibilities: Cockpit UI: top nav (VE, Perspectives, Workspace, Content); App.tsx workspace modes POST /run and /run/stream
Perspectives view; server persistence for perspective agents when signed in (VE council-workspace API); localStorage cache
Vision Execution view (entities, Radar, meeting extract); app header focus context strip + voice (VeFocusRegion, council synthetic focus, inline create forms)

Shared client AI substrate: frontend/src/ai-actions (AiActionTrace, action_kind, optional action_intent, AiActionResultPanel) — wired for VE rewrite, project suggested work, initiative/idea evaluate traces
Content: briefs, /run generation, distill-source, TranscriptSorter
Intake: config, OAuth, poll, queue list, PATCH item, judgment
modules.notes: Single large App.tsx. Workspace/Content /run flows: trace coverage per ai-actions/aiTraceExemptRegistry.ts. No route uses get_item_with_content (Tier B/C by product contract).

modules.name: file_steward
responsibilities: Folder scan, analyze, recommend children, assess plan strength, simulate folder plan
Invoked via atria_tools (lazy import); not a registered adapter
modules.notes: Stateless per request. No policy layer integration.

modules.name: mailbox_ingestion
responsibilities: IMAP config (env or intake_imap_config.json), Gmail OAuth flow and XOAUTH2
Poll mailboxes, normalize body, run pipeline, add_item; duplicate detection by external_id
persisted_data: OAuth tokens and config on disk; no sync state written after poll
modules.notes: Read-only mailbox access. set_sync_state not called after poll. No MailboxAdapter.

modules.name: synthetic_evaluation
responsibilities: Generate synthetic intake cases (JSON datasets)
Evaluate pipeline on cases; export failures; review scripts
pytest: test_intake_quality, test_intake_synthetic_regression
modules.notes: Two generate scripts; canonical dataset path not formalized. Evaluation does not touch live mirror.

modules.name: intake_access_policy_shim
responsibilities: Re-export local_ai.policy.data_access for backward compatibility
modules.notes: Deprecated. New code should use local_ai.policy.data_access only.
